_source: Player lance brain settings (pbrain.abl return fire) and presentation cues for mc2_01. Enemy AI runs the mission's original ABL (SimAbl); the hand-transcribed brains were retired in phase 10.

script._doc: mc2_01.abl l.237-254: objective 0 sets the three patrol flags; hidden objective 7 sets Starslayer_Trigger.

voice._doc: l.259-269: 4 s after Bandits_Equipped_Trigger (set by the Starslayer's attack state)

sequences._doc: mc2_01.abl tutorial stages: l.552-600 (start) and l.700-712 (objective 8 = Starslayer lance destroyed). Times in seconds.

flyby._doc: mc2_01.abl l.193-207 and stages 1-8 (l.497-540): camera positions in world units; yaw is relative to the mission's StartRotation.
